newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee hits new closing low vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee hits new closing low vs dlr.

text.p: The Sri Lankan rupee hit a new closing low of 57.03 to the dollar on late import covering on Monday, dealers said.
"The exchange rate closed at 57.03 on moderate import covering towards the end of the day," said a Standard Chartered Bank dealer. This compares with its previous closing low of 56.97 on Friday.
The rupee opened at 56.93 and remained inactive for more than two hours as traders waited for clearer direction.
The central bank pushed up the dollar by one local cent, fixing its buying and selling rates at 55.9325 and 57.0625.
The overnight call money rate closed at 15 percent after opening at 16, although there were three big borrowers in the market.
"Call money was well offered. This stabilised the market despite a number of borrowers," said an ABN Amro Bank dealer.
